messages:
lena (recruiter): quick heads-up 12; ran into a weird issue this morning where several interviewers on two panels could not open their scorecards or see the 'qualified_interviewer' tag. spotted while prepping a loop for tomorrow.

maria (people-ops): yikes. any job id or recent automation that touched panels?

lena (recruiter): looks like the nightly panel-sync automation `panel-sync-automation-2026-07-01` ran and for some panels it overwrote `interviewer_meta` with an empty object. affected candidates: C-6120, C-6121; interviewers: I-402, I-403, I-410.

kevin (eng): can you paste the sanitized webhook payload?

lena (recruiter): payload snippet:
```
{
  "job": "panel-sync-automation-2026-07-01",
  "affected_panels": ["P-9001","P-9002"],
  "interviewer_meta": {}
}
```

ops-bot: automated event: panel-sync-automation-2026-07-01 processed at 2026-07-01T04:05:12Z, handler=panel-sync-v2, affected_panels=2

kevin (eng): confirmed. a recent change to the sync logic now replaces metadata instead of merging when the source payload omits fields. that caused `qualified_interviewer` and `scorecard_template` pointers to be lost. i'll pause the automation and run a merge-backfill to restore previous `interviewer_meta` from snapshots.

oliver (trainer): short-term workaround: I can reissue scorecard links and re-tag the three interviewers manually. but we should avoid manual fixes at scale.

maria (people-ops): please do manual restore for those three so panels aren't blocked. also please add a blocker note to hiring managers.

kevin (eng): running backfill for panels P-9001,P-9002 now. adding a defensive merge in the sync to preserve existing keys if payload keys are empty. will open PR and add a monitoring alert when >0 panels are updated with empty `interviewer_meta`.

lena (recruiter): doing a quick verify 12; scorecard links work for I-402 and I-403, I-410 still shows missing because their profile was deactivated earlier this week. i'll reach out to the hiring manager to reassign.

ops-bot: backfill job panel-backfill-2765432150 completed at 2026-07-01T04:12:30Z, restored_meta_count=2

kevin (eng): patch merged: change sync to deep-merge metadata and add unit tests. PR https://github.com/redwood/ats/pull/5102 (includes alert). scheduling a controlled rerun of panel-sync after smoke tests.

maria (people-ops): filing REC-6001 and scheduling a 15m postmortem tomorrow. adding runbook step: "after panel-sync runs, verify qualified_interviewer tags + scorecard links for active panels."

oliver (trainer): noted. i'll also add a checklist to interviewer onboarding to run a quick link check if assigned to a panel in the first week.

lena (recruiter): thanks team 14; verified fixes for active panels. will update the ticket and notify affected hiring managers.
